description: This file contains the code-behind for the Calculator view in a UWP app, managing UI interactions, state changes, and event handling for different calculator modes (Standard, Scientific, Programmer).

classes.name: FontTable
classes.description: Defines font sizes for different numeric systems and orientations.

classes.name: Calculator
classes.description: Main view class for the calculator, handling UI state, events, and interactions.
